text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Helios renewal in ~45 days. Need a compact QBR package focused on token economics + immediate cost ops. Who can pull current month-to-date burn + 90d forecast?
Samir: MTD burn attached in the dashboard, rough numbers here: $48k this month, projected $160k over 90d at current pace. Embeddings ~62% of tokens, chat gen ~28%, reranking & infra rest.
Lena: Noted. Onboarding still has 3 big accounts hitting high embed usage — I've flagged two for enablement. We'll need a short slide on onboarding blockers + actions.
Diego: Renewal risk: account is price-sensitive. If we can show a path to 20-30% unit-cost reduction via batching/commit we'll likely avoid churn. Need a forecast with and without recommended ops.
Finance Bot: ALERT: Helios exceeded monthly budget threshold (75%) — https://redwood.internal/finance/alerts/helios-2198765432 :warning:
Aisha: Quick wins we can include: enable prefix caching for frequent templates; reduce embedding dimensionality where acceptable; suggested runtime config:```
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 8
kv_cache: true
quantization: q4_0
```
Samir: If we apply those, I estimate a 22% cost reduction baseline (conservative). I'll run a short sim on last 30d trace to validate.
Product Ops: Two asks for QBR: 1) show expected quality delta for each optimization (evals/PSNR-style metrics ok), 2) include enablement timeline (who does what by when).
Lena: I'll own the enablement timeline + 1-pager for the QBR. Targeting draft by Tue EOD. :calendar:
Diego: I'll own the commercial levers slide (commit tiers + proposed discount). Can someone give me the 90d with/without ops by Mon noon?
Maya: Great. Owners: Samir = forecast sims, Lena = enablement 1-pager, Diego = commercial ask. Product Ops, can you run quick evals on embedding-quality at reduced dims and tag any regressions?
Product Ops: On it. Will run lightweight evals (100 samples) and post summary. :mag_right:
Aisha: I can prototype a caching config and a small AB test script for prefix caching — will drop results in the thread.
Finance Bot: NOTE: Billing export for Helios enclosed — /exports/helios-2198765432.csv (generated).
Samir: Pulled the export, starting sims now. Expect results by Mon 11:30 PST.
Lena: Draft 1-pager posted to drive: https://drive.redwood/helios-qbr/one-pager (feedback welcome).
Diego: Added initial commercial scenarios to the shared slide deck. Need the sim numbers to finalize recommended commit.
Maya: Thanks team. Plan: consolidate slides by Tue 3pm, rehearsals Wed AM. If we hit the cost-reduction numbers we push a tailored commit proposal in the QBR. Anything else?
Lena: Add customer feedback note — they called out latency spikes during onboarding tests. Might be worth including a short mitigation note (KV cache + smaller batch sizes during cold-start).
Aisha: Good call — I'll add latency charts to my AB test results.
Diego: +1. Also loop in Solutions SE on the call.
Maya: I'll schedule the QBR invite and include all owners. Thanks — please keep updates in this thread so I can copy into the QBR notes. :thumbsup:
